name: super-el-nino
description: Community coordination for people preparing for, responding to, and recovering from El Niño impacts.

interface.longDescription: Find preparedness resources, safely draft community offers or needs, and create response-plan templates for El Niño impacts. Drafts and plans are not published or stored. Check current local authority guidance before acting.
defaultPrompt: Find El Niño preparedness resources for my region.
Help me draft a safe public offer of skills, time, or supplies for El Niño preparation.
Create a response-plan template for my community.
